class_id: a fragment read from a hard layout vetoes a complete value read elsewhere in the same document
feature: any reader that cross-checks the same value across places in one document and fails closed on disagreement, where one place has a layout (multi-column, wrapped table) that the text extraction splits
symptom: fail-closed agreement is meant to stop wrong values, but when one place yields a truncated fragment ('India Private Limited') or a row that overruns, the disagreement nulls the correct full value too, and with it every attribute read alongside it. The field ends up empty for every document with that layout.
first_seen: 2026-10-03 -- IPODhan NSE DRHP page 2: lead_managers_row_overrun nulls all 20 BRLMs; registrar 'India Private Limited' (cover) vs 'MUFG Intime India Private Limited' (GI p91) -> registrar_sources_disagree nulls name, email, phone, website. F-243.
fix_prs: open -- treat a fragment that is a suffix/subset of the full reading as agreement, and isolate an overrunning row instead of failing the whole list; proven on 3 real covers
